name: Bloodtooth Camp
summary: In central Ashenvale, Bloodtooth Camp lies west of the Falfarren River. Ran Bloodtooth leads the corrupted furbolgs, who attack anyone who approaches. Alliance scouts target the camp as they work to cleanse the surrounding woodlands.

sections.title: A Corrupted Den
sections.body: Bloodtooth Camp lies southwest of the southern Moonwell and west of the Falfarren River. Its furbolgs were once bound to Kalimdor's sacred wilderness, but a lingering spiritual corruption has consumed their tribe. Ran Bloodtooth commands the crude settlement. His followers attack travelers and night elven protectors alike.

sections.title: Cleansing the Forest
sections.body: Ran Bloodtooth's band threatens nearby sacred sites, drawing Alliance sentinels and their allies to the camp. As they aid Raene Wolfrunner's efforts to cleanse the forest, Krolg directs adventurers to enter the camp, kill Ran Bloodtooth, and defeat his bodyguards.

faq.answer: Bloodtooth Camp lies in central Ashenvale, west of the Falfarren River and southwest of the southern Moonwell.

faq.q: Why are the furbolgs here hostile?
faq.answer: A dark demonic corruption lingering in Ashenvale's wilderness has driven the Bloodtooth clan, like many furbolg tribes there, into madness and aggression toward outsiders.

faq.q: Who leads the furbolgs at Bloodtooth Camp?
faq.answer: Ran Bloodtooth leads the furbolgs at the camp and commands his bodyguards.

faq.q: Why does the Alliance send scouts here?
faq.answer: During the efforts around Raene's Cleansing, Krolg, an exiled furbolg, directs Alliance champions to attack the camp, kill Ran Bloodtooth, and remove the threat his followers pose to the region.

angles.text: For Alliance adventurers, Bloodtooth Camp is a pocket of corruption threatening Ashenvale's southern groves and moonwells.
As a night elf, you see Ran Bloodtooth's maddened tribe as a tragic sign of the corruption blighting your ancestral homeland.
